digest.component_or_area: LLM framework provider resolution and OpenAI integration
propositions: Hosted OpenAI (bare openai:/inferred gpt-*/o1/o3/chatgpt without custom endpoint) must resolve to openai-responses: by default
Custom endpoints (top-level base_url, per-slot endpoint, or per-candidate endpoint) must stay on openai-chat: with no Responses alternative
explicit openai-chat: qualifier carries a deprecation notice scheduled for removal in v1.0.0 and applies once per run for hosted OpenAI only
Provider resolution logic must thread endpoint information through resolve_class, resolve_fallback_chain, primary_endpoint_for, fallback_targets_for, and build_fallback_model to maintain consistency
openai-responses: must be registered in config resolution and provider detection without being handled by rebar's chat-only builder, deferring to pydantic-ai
Capability resolution for openai-responses: must achieve parity with openai-chat: on native_structured_output and other features
